synopsis: The sequel to "Babel II" set a few years after Yomi's defeat. This time Babel's enemies are the US military and the CIA, who are interested in using Babel's power for their own nefarious purposes after Babel had given them a sample of his own blood to use for charitable purposes. Not only will Babel be forced to fight against adversaries endowed with his own powers, but he will also not be able to count on the help of his trusted companions, imprisoned in a place where not even his brainwaves can reach them. A true ending to Babel II, completely ignoring Part 4 of the original manga. Note: Includes one-shot "Point 4".

title: In Another World With My Smartphone
titleRomaji: Isekai wa Smartphone to Tomo ni.
titleEnglish: In Another World With My Smartphone
titleNative: 異世界はスマートフォンとともに。
synopsis: After a freak accident involving some lightning winds up zapping him dead, 15-year-old Mochizuki Touya wakes up to find himself face-to-face with God. “I am afraid to say that I have made a bit of a blunder...” laments the old coot. But all is not lost! God says that he can reincarnate Touya into a world of fantasy, and as a bonus, he gets to bring his smartphone along with! So begins Touya's adventure in a new, anachronistic pseudo-medieval world. Friends! Laughs! Tears! Inexplicable Deus ex Machina! He sets off on a journey full of wonder as he absentmindedly travels from place to place, following whatever goal catches his fancy. The curtains lift on an epic tale of swords, sorcery, and smartphone apps! (Source: J-Novel Club)

synonyms: My Guilty First Love With Another Girl's Girlfriend
synopsis: "In exchange for my help with your studies, you must stay let me stay at your house until summer vacation." If I get a failing mark again, my chance to live by myself will be over. So I'm forced to go along with the proposal from Tsukasa, the smartest and most beautiful girl in school. But then I saw them. I saw Tsukasa kissing a girl in the park. Tsukasa, who often annoys me with her abnormal invasions of my personal space, has a “girlfriend." Her yuri friend is against this arrangement because she thinks it's “cheating” even if it's between two girls, but Tsukasa is having none of it. After a while, my grades are improving and I'm beginning to enjoy living with Tsukasa. I know that “it's not cheating if you're not in love with them,” but… I'm okay with it. If I don't think about love, we can all get along and be happy, right? (Source: Dengeki Bunko, translated)
